description.value: You can tell a mutated edible root from a poisoned one by smell alone, most of the time. You don't take a circumstance penalty to Subsist using Nature in irradiated or ash-blighted terrain, and a critical failure is downgraded to a normal failure.

cinderfall.incomplete: Both the circumstance-penalty removal and the critical-failure downgrade are gated on 'irradiated or ash-blighted terrain', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one. Real Forager (the confirmed AdjustDegreeOfSuccess precedent for Subsist) ships its equivalent adjustment unconditionally, with no terrain gate to fail on; this card's terrain-conditioned version has nothing to predicate the gate against.
